title.hr: Devet bitova dozvola, oktalni zapis i umask
title.en: Nine permission bits, octal notation and umask

concept.hr: Devet bitova u tri zapisa; umask briše bitove: 666 uz 077 daje 600
concept.en: Nine bits written three ways; umask clears bits: 666 with 077 gives 600

summary.hr: Klikni bitove, primijeni chmod oktalno ili simbolički, postavi masku i stvori datoteku: oktalni zapis piše svih devet bitova, maska ih briše, ne oduzima.
summary.en: Click bits, apply chmod in octal or symbolic form, set the mask and create a file: octal writes all nine bits, the mask clears bits rather than subtracting.

title.en: Octal chmod erases a bit nobody named

concept.hr: chmod 640 na rwx------ odnosi izvršni bit vlasnika
concept.en: chmod 640 on rwx------ takes the owner's execute bit

concept.hr: Maska briše bitove iz 666, ne oduzima broj
concept.en: The mask clears bits from 666; it does not subtract
